name: Upheal
description: Upheal is an AI-native EHR built specifically for therapists that combines documentation with session analytics—a capability no other platform offers. Beyond generating notes in under 60 seconds, Upheal analyzes sessions for talking ratios, sentiment trends, speech patterns, and silence detection. The Golden Thread feature tracks client progress session-to-session. Upheal includes HIPAA-compliant telehealth video, insurance billing ($0.30/claim), and a pay-per-session pricing model ($1/session capped at $69/mo) that works for low-volume practitioners.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.description: Unlimited typed notes. No audio/video recording. Limited session analytics.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: 50 session notes. Basic analytics, SOAP/DAP formats, manual session uploads.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.description: 100 session notes. BIRP, EMDR, GIRP formats. Recorder for in-person. Full session analytics. Transcript access.

pricing.notes: Pay-per-session model works well for low-volume practitioners. Telehealth calls through Upheal count as sessions. Session analytics require paid plan.

ambient_ai.description: Notes generated in under 60 seconds. AI learns your writing style with each edit.

session_analytics.description: Unique feature: talking ratio, sentiment trends, speech patterns, silence detection, topic frequency—tracked along the session timeline.

golden_thread.description: Tracks client progress session-to-session. Insurance-compliant AI-generated treatment plans.

telehealth.description: Built-in HIPAA-compliant video sessions with integrated AI recording.

short_description: AI-native EHR with session analytics that no other scribe offers: talking ratios, sentiment tracking, Golden Thread progress monitoring. $1/session pricing.
one_liner: The only AI therapy scribe with real-time session analytics and pay-per-session pricing.

faqs.q: How much does Upheal cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Upheal offers a free tier (typed notes only), Starter at $19/mo or $1/session (50 notes), and Premium at $69/mo or $1/session capped (100 notes). Additional fees: card payments 2.9% + $0.30, claims $0.30 each, eligibility checks $0.15 each.

faqs.q: What session analytics does Upheal provide?
faqs.a: Upheal is unique among AI scribes in offering real-time session analytics: talking ratio, sentiment trends, speech patterns, silence detection, and topic frequency. These metrics are tracked along the session timeline to help therapists understand therapeutic dynamics.

faqs.q: What is Upheal's Golden Thread feature?
faqs.a: Golden Thread tracks client progress session-to-session and generates insurance-compliant treatment plans. It helps maintain documentation continuity that payers require.

faqs.q: Upheal vs Mentalyc: which is better for therapists?
faqs.a: Choose Upheal if you want session analytics (talk-time, sentiment) or prefer pay-per-session pricing. Choose Mentalyc if you want Alliance Genie relationship tracking or prefer flat-rate monthly subscriptions. Both are therapy-specific; neither is designed for medication management.
